page.layout: One printed page, single text column, with a running head at the top, page number at the top right, and a gathering signature at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Quanquam sequente consonante possunt vsurpari aut integræ, aut trucatæ, sed absque apostropho. Significatione vero, & vsum earum, vt hactenus fecimus, typis adscriptis ostendemus.
main_text.head: ME ~ NE
main_text.p: Mihi de illo, illa, illis, Me ne parlásti, Parlástimene, Mihi de illo, illa, illis es locutus. Me hinc, illinc, istinc, Me ne scacciò, scacciómmene, Me hinc, illinc, istinc expulit. ¶ Ego hinc, &c. Me ne vò, Vómmene, Ego hinc, illinc, istinc discedo.
main_text.head: TE ~ NE
main_text.p: Tibi de illo, illa, illis, Io te ne parlái, Parlá-tene, Tibi de illo, illa, illis sum locuto. Te hinc, illinc, istinc, Te ne scacciò, scacciòttene, Te hinc, illinc, istinc expulit. Tu hinc, illinc, istinc, Tu te ne partisti, Partistitene, Tu hinc, illinc, discessisti.
main_text.head: SE ~ NE
main_text.p: Sibi de illo, illa, illis, Se ne promise, Promisesene gran cóse, Sibi de illo, illa, illis, magna promisit.
Ipse hinc, illinc, istinc, Se ne parti, Partissene, Ipse hinc, illinc, istinc discessit.

page.notes: Swung dash in the headings ME ~ NE, TE ~ NE, SE ~ NE stands for a printed wavy ornament between the pronouns. Catchword absent. Some words in the italic verse are doubtful.
